title: Comprehensive Inventory of City-owned Artwork / City Art Collection / Condition of Each Object / Consistent Inventory and Documentation Process / Policies for Aqcuisition, Conservation and Relocation
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that City Council instruct the Office of the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the Department of Cultural Affairs and all relevant City departments to report to the City Council on requirements to establish a comprehensive inventory of City-owned artwork, including artworks located in City-owned, leased, operated, or managed facilities. To the extent possible, the report should note the condition of each object and if each artwork and object is a part of the official City Art Collection. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: ====== pvudakvRugyu molar mrae • MONICA RODRIGUEZ Q Councilwoman, 7th District OCT o 4226

requests.asks: Requirements for a comprehensive inventory of City-owned artwork, noting each object's condition and whether it is part of the official City Art Collection.
